decisionsTitle: «Note interne» on the «Voluntari» list: the words without their day, and a volunteer's note changed by its author or an Administrator (amending §935, §945 and §950)
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-11-17, on a phone, four days before Saturday's race, on the «Voluntari» list** — whose «Note interne» column read, for instance, «Mar., 17 nov. 2026, 10:30: Fotograf» and «Lun., 16 nov. 2026, 13:18: sotia lui Stefan»: «și tot în tabelul ăsta, la nota internă nu mai afișa și data, și lasă-mă să editez și nota internă». Two things: the column shows the notes' words without their day and hour, and an internal note can be changed — until now one was only added («Adaugă o notă») or deleted («Șterge», on the person's page).

**What was there.** The list's column «Note interne» (§950) and the tooltip of the notes marker beside the name (§945) said the three newest notes, each after its day and hour («Mar., 17 nov. 2026, 10:30: Fotograf»), the older ones counted. On a phone the column is a line of the person's card, and the day and the hour took half of each line on a race week, when what the organizers read the list for is what the note says.

**Decision 1 — no date in the list.** On the «Voluntari» list the column and the marker's tooltip say each shown note's words alone: newest first, a blank line between two, a note's own line breaks kept, a long one cut, the older ones counted as before («… și încă 1 notă»), and still no author. The order says which is the latest; the day, the hour and the author are the person's page's, where every note keeps all three — the thread is the record. Only this list changes: `notesTip` takes `when` null to leave the day out, and its other callers — the registrations list's marker (§943, §945) and the marker on the event card's «Voluntari» rows — pass their clock and read exactly what they read before. The column's «?» says so.

**Decision 2 — the verb, `editVolunteerNote` (`modules/volunteers/volunteer-notes.ts`), beside the delete and with its gate.** First that the actor keeps notes (`canManageVolunteers`: the Organizer, the Administrator, the Superadministrator), then that the note is theirs or that they change registrations (`canManageRegistrations`: the Administrator and above). One rule for both verbs (`mayChangeNote`), because a change can take a note's words away as surely as a delete can — rewriting a colleague's note is deleting it with new words in its place — so whoever may not delete a colleague's note may not rewrite it, and the Administrator, who may delete any, may correct any; a note nobody can be named for (a carried line, an author's account gone) is the Administrator's, as for «Șterge». The words are read as an add reads them (`parseVolunteerNoteBody`: `NOTE_EMPTY`, `NOTE_TOO_LONG`, naming the box `body`); a deleted note, one that is not there and a malformed id are NOT_FOUND; the same words after that reading are no change — nothing written, nothing in the trail. A change is one transaction: `body` and `updated_at`, never `created_at` or the author, so the note keeps its place in the thread and its byline — a correction of what a note says is not a new note, and re-dating it would put an old fact at the top as the latest; one `volunteer.note_edited` row says who and when as every `volunteer.*` row does (entity `event`, the event's id) with `{ volunteerId }` and never the words, before or after — a trail row outlives the note it is about, so words in it would be the note kept after its owner changed it; and, as for «Șterge», when the volunteer's old single line (`event_volunteers.note`, carried into a note by `0196`) held the note's old words, the column is cleared in the same transaction, so the old words do not outlive their change. No email is queued and no public cache tag is expired: nothing a visitor or the person reads moves.

**Decision 3 — on the list.** In the «Note interne» cell, under the words, «Modifică nota» — the pencil and the look of «Modifică decizia» in the next column, 44 pixels — opens the row's dialog (`RowNoteDialog`) with the newest note's words in the box and the person's name in its title («Modifică nota despre {name}»). It is drawn only when the reader may change that note — its author, or an Administrator; older notes are changed on the person's page, so the row stays one press. The save is `editVolunteerNoteFromListAction`, the last function of `admin/volunteers/actions.ts`: the capability at the door, the service asking again, a refusal (empty, too long, a note deleted meanwhile, another role, a session that ended) said in the dialog with the words kept, and a save back to the same list address — filters, sort and page — through the volunteers' one validated return (`backToCard`); a forged `returnTo` lands on the event's own «Voluntari» card, as the row's other two dialogs do. The toast is «Nota a fost modificată.», or the house's «Era deja așa; nimic de schimbat.» for the same words. With no script the press is a link to the person's notes (`#note-interne`). The list reads its notes in one grouped query of its own (`listVolunteerNotesForList`: the words, and each note's id and whether the reader may change it), never one per row and never an author.

**Decision 4 — on the person's page.** Each note the reader may change has «Modifică» beside «Șterge»: a native fold in the note's line, holding its words in a box and «Salvează nota», its header drawn as the line's other press — the pencil and the word, the glyph every fold's header wears (§521) — and taking the line's width while open. A fold rather than the list's dialog: the list's «Modifică nota» lands here when no script runs, so the form must work without one — and it opens by itself after a refusal (`RecallDetails`). The press (`editVolunteerNoteAction`, the card's own `note-actions.ts`) comes back to the card, open (`?saved=noteEdited#note-interne`). The card is the registrations' `NotesCard`, which draws «Modifică» only when the page hands it an `editAction`: the registration's page hands none.

**Not in this change.** Editing a registration's internal notes (§777) — the owner asked about the volunteers' table, and a registration's notes keep their add and delete. A mark «modificată» on an edited note. Any history of a note's earlier words: the trail says who changed it and when, never what it said.

**No migration and no dependency**: `event_volunteer_notes` has had `updated_at` since `0196`.
changelogLine: - **«Note interne» on the «Voluntari» list: the words without the day, and a note can be changed** — the column and the marker's tooltip say the newest notes' words alone, with no day or hour (the person's page keeps both, and the author); «Modifică nota» under the words changes the newest note from its row, and on the person's page «Modifică» stands beside «Șterge» on each note the reader may change — its author's, or any for an Administrator. A change keeps the note's place in the thread, emails nobody and is audited without the words. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Amends criteria 224 and 231 for the «Voluntari» list alone. Given a volunteer with internal notes, then the «Voluntari» list's column «Note interne» and its notes marker's tooltip say the three newest live notes' words alone — newest first, a blank line between two, a note's own line breaks kept, a long one cut, the older ones counted — with no day, no hour and no author, in Romanian and in English; the registrations list's marker and the marker on the event card's «Voluntari» rows keep each note's day and hour, and the volunteer's page keeps every note's day, hour and author (2026-11-17, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a volunteer's live internal note, then whoever manages the volunteers may change its words when the note is their own, and an Administrator or a Superadministrator any note (`editVolunteerNote`, the delete's rule): the words are read as an add reads them — refused `NOTE_EMPTY` or `NOTE_TOO_LONG` naming the box `body` — a deleted, missing or malformed note is NOT_FOUND, the same words write and audit nothing, and a change writes the words and `updated_at` and never `created_at` or the author, records `volunteer.note_edited` with `{ volunteerId }` and never the words, before or after, clears the volunteer's old single line (`event_volunteers.note`) when it held the note's old words, queues no email and expires no public cache tag (2026-11-17, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given the «Voluntari» list, when a row's newest note is the reader's own or the reader is an Administrator, then under the words of its «Note interne» cell stands «Modifică nota» / "Edit the note" — a 44-pixel press named «Modifică nota despre {name}» — that opens the row's dialog on that note's words, whose save returns to the same list address (filters, sort and page) with «Nota a fost modificată.», or «Era deja așa; nimic de schimbat.» for the same words, whose refusal is said in the dialog with the words kept, and which with no script is a link to the person's notes; an Organizer sees none on a row whose newest note is a colleague's. On the volunteer's page each note the reader may change has «Modifică» / "Edit" beside «Șterge», a fold — its header the pencil, hidden from a screen reader, and the word — holding its words in a box with «Salvează nota», whose save returns to `#note-interne` with the card open; the registration's page has no «Modifică» (2026-11-17, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a volunteer's internal note, when the Tehnic role, the Redactor, the desk Volunteer or a member changes it, or an Organizer a colleague's — through `editVolunteerNoteFromListAction`, `editVolunteerNoteAction` or the service — then it is refused FORBIDDEN, the actions asking `canManageVolunteers` at their door and the service asking it again and then whose note it is, and nothing is written or audited; a session that ended is UNAUTHENTICATED, with the words kept in the box (2026-11-17, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: «Note interne» on the «Voluntari» list say the words without the day, and a volunteer's note can be changed («Modifică nota», «Modifică»)
